intent: Session attribution: native Windows PID walk (fixes the recurring TestPidWalker CI flake)
notes: `precommit_session.py` (wheel template and Enterprise bundled copy, byte-identical): the Windows parent-PID walk now uses kernel32 (`CreateToolhelp32Snapshot` for the parent PID, `GetProcessTimes` for the start time) via `_get_process_info_windows_native`. It falls back to the previous PowerShell `Get-CimInstance` path (`_get_process_info_windows_powershell`) only when the native path cannot find the process or read its start time; a PowerShell start time is used with a native parent PID only when both agree. Cause: the PowerShell cold start could exceed its 10 s limit on a busy machine, so the walk returned `[]` — 4 Windows CI failures of `TestPidWalker` since 2026-09-21, and silent loss of commit-to-session attribution on slow user machines.

`_filetime_to_cim_iso` formats FILETIME exactly like the recorder (`gator-session-start.py` PowerShell `CreationDate.ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')`): whole microseconds, 7 fractional digits ending in 0. Verified byte-identical to CIM on 7 live processes before the change.

Tests (`tests/test_multi_session.py`): `TestWindowsNativeProcessInfo` (known-answer format vectors, native/PowerShell fallback rules, live native lookup and unknown PID on Windows) and `test_first_hop_is_the_real_parent_on_windows`.
Charters: new `_walk_parent_pids` / process-info entry with the exact-format TRIPWIRE in `scripts-precommit.md`; bundled-copy note in `scripts-enterprise-cli.md`.

Significance check (cross-module invariant: recorder ↔ walker start-time strings). Steelman against: a native start time that differs by even one digit from the recorded CIM string silently breaks attribution, which is worse than the flake. Mitigations: exact-format verification against CIM on live processes, a pinned known-answer test, and the PowerShell fallback whenever the native start time is unavailable. Verification: every test file referencing the changed modules (170 passed) and the full CI fast suite locally (2266 passed).
